metadata.name: FAQ Liquid Accordion
metadata.description: An FAQ accordion with live search: matches are painted by a sweeping marker and a count shows how many questions match. Opening a question releases a circular liquid ripple from the plus button while the answer blurs in word by word.
metadata.author: vovalopuh13
